desc.zh: 外贝加尔的小朝廷还捧着两本册子：一本记旗丁的月粮，一本记垦户的税粮。册子越旧，欠得越多；先把粮册理清，才谈得上别的。
desc.en: The small court at Transbaikal still holds two registers: one for the bannermen's monthly grain, one for the settlers' tax grain. The older the books, the larger the arrears; only by putting the grain registers in order does anything else become possible.

desc.zh: 朝廷的名号之下，还住着布里亚特牧户、哥萨克垦户与海岛上的通信人。谁能算朝廷的属民、谁只算客籍，以及往来书信该用谁的名号，将决定留下的究竟是朝廷还是别的什么。
desc.en: Beneath the dynastic style live Buryat herders, Cossack settlers and correspondents across the sea. Who counts as the court's own, who stays a registered guest, and whose name the letters carry, will decide whether what remains is a court or something else.

title.en: The Eight Banners Still Must Eat Grain

desc.zh: 户部的旧册还按月记着旗丁的米粮，可陆上的地租连俸库都填不满。管票的章京把两本册子摊在案上：旗饷一日不改，垦户的税就一日收不齐。
desc.en: The old board register still records the bannermen's monthly grain, yet the land rents on the steppe can no longer fill the stipend stores. The secretary in charge of ration tickets spreads both books on the desk: while the stipend goes unchanged, the settlers' tax can never be collected in full.

desc.en: The banner register counts men, the settler register counts land, and in Transbaikal the two disagree: the same river valley is pasture in one book and new fields in the other. The clerks propose merging the rolls; the banner commanders will accept only an appendix.

desc.en: The year is up and the old offices carry the review upward: where the rolls merged, the grain tax comes in full; where settlers waited in an appendix, two books still disagree. New tax sources have been found, but how the court owns this account is still its word to give.

desc.zh: 科尔沁的旗册认牧道，新垦的田契认犁沟，两本册子在同一个旗署里对不上账。盟旗的兵额、租谷的税源、牧道的存废，都要先从这两册并一册说起。
desc.en: Khorchin's banner roll knows the herding corridors and the settlers' deeds know furrows, and the two books do not agree inside the same banner office. The league's quota of horsemen, the tithe's revenue and the survival of the pastures all begin with making these two rolls one account.

title.en: A Seat Within the League Compact

desc.zh: 旗地与犁沟的账既已结算，科尔沁要面对外面的盟约与里面的新一代：互保之约有没有作实，租地人的下一代记在哪一册，续签盟书时谁的名字可以落笔。
desc.en: With the banner-land and furrow accounts settled, Khorchin faces the league without and the next generation within: whether the mutual guarantee was confirmed, which roll holds the lessees' children, and whose names may sign when the compact is renewed.

title.en: A New Field Deed Beside the Pasture

desc.zh: 同一条牧场边界上，新垦的田块头一次有人拿来了书面田契：签契的是迁来的耕户，放牧的仍是旧日的旗丁。旗署的旧册只认牧道，新契只认犁沟，谁也说不清这块地该记在哪一册。
desc.en: Along the same pasture boundary, a newly ploughed parcel has brought its first written deed: the signers are settler households, while the riders on the old herding rows are still the banner troopers of former days. The banner office's old register knows only the herding corridors, the new deed knows only furrows, and nobody can say which book the parcel belongs in.

title.en: How Many Horsemen the League Banners Will Give

desc.en: Before the new roll is dry, the league letter has arrived: the marches are unsettled and the league banners call on Khorchin to field men according to its register. Custom let each banner fix its own number; now that the roll holds both troopers and plough households, how many, from whom, and paid with what must be written as a fixed count for the first time.

title.en: The Proposal for a Fixed Tithe

desc.zh: 垦户的田契既已入册，税吏便带来了提案：把新田的租谷折成固定税额，岁岁可征。旗署算得出进项，也算得出代价——租谷一行写进册子，牧道就得让出春秋两季的草场；保住牧道，财政上的许诺就得缩回去。
desc.en: With the settlers' deeds on the roll, the tax clerks bring a proposal: convert the new fields' rent grain into a fixed tithe that can be collected every year. The banner office can count the intake and the price in the same breath — every line of rent grain written into the roll narrows the spring and autumn pastures, and keeping the herding corridors whole means shrinking what the treasury has promised.

title.en: Gifts Sent Separately by the Neighbours

desc.zh: 开春的礼单摆了一案：南边与垦务有来往的官署送了茶砖，草原上会盟的邻旗送了鞍马。两家都提到同一句话——沿边牧道与田界，愿立互保之约。只是礼是分别送来的，条款也各写各的，约期定多久，得科尔沁自己拿主意。
desc.en: The spring gift lists fill the desk: the southern magistracies that deal in land settlement send brick tea, and the neighbouring league banners of the steppe send saddled horses. Both speak the same words — the border herding corridors and field boundaries should stand under a mutual guarantee. But the gifts came separately and each wrote its own terms; the term of years is Khorchin's to set.

cost_note.en: New-roll fee: half a week of opening income (deferred if the treasury cannot cover it).

consequence_note.zh: 新一代自此有自己的册行，役与税各认各的；旧牧册与新田册并立为两卷。
consequence_note.en: The next generation gains rows of their own, obligations and taxes counted separately; the old herding roll and the new field roll stand as two volumes.

label.zh: 旧册不改：新一代附于父契之下
label.en: The old roll stands: the next generation rides on their fathers' leases

consequence_note.zh: 省下造册费，册子还是那一册；新一代的不满会写进最后一站的记录。
consequence_note.en: The fee is saved and the roll stays as it was; the next generation's grievance enters the final stage's record.

label.en: Hold the generational question

consequence_note.en: The generational question waits; names keep piling up under the old leases.

title.en: Who May Renew the League Compact

desc.zh: 旧约的期限到了：垦牧两册并行的年头里，当年签字的王公有的故去，有的不再管事。新一代的册行、租地的长老、牧道上的旗丁，都问着同一句话——续写盟书的时候，谁的名字可以落在纸上。
desc.en: The old compact's term has run out: in the years since the twin rolls began, princes who signed it have died or stepped back. The new generation's roll rows, the leaseholding elders and the troopers of the herding corridors all ask the same question — when the league compact is written anew, whose names may fall upon the page.

label.zh: 广续盟书：王公与册户同列签约
label.en: Renew broadly: princes and roll households sign alike

cost_note.zh: 会盟仪费：开启时半月财政收入（存钱不足则此案暂缓）。
cost_note.en: Assembly cost: half a week of opening income (deferred if the treasury cannot cover it).

consequence_note.zh: 制度自此巩固：两册之人同具盟书，续约之权写成年例；垦牧并册与互保确认的记录一并入盟书正文。
consequence_note.en: The institution is consolidated: both rolls' people sign the compact and renewal rights become standing custom; the twin-ledger and confirmed-guarantee records enter the compact's own text.

label.zh: 限额妥协：册户入盟以定额为限
label.en: A quota compromise: roll households enter the league under a fixed cap

options.effect: { if = { limit = { ywc_khq_at_1105 = yes } set_variable = { name = ywc_khq_b_outcome value = 2 } set_variable = { name = ywc_khq_quota_compromise value = 1 } remove_variable = ywc_khq_b_pending remove_variable = ywc_khq_b_stage change_variable = { name = ywc_khq_popup_epoch add = 1 } } }

consequence_note.zh: 盟书续了，席位有限额；超额的册户候补，争议留待下一代再提。
consequence_note.en: The compact renews with capped seats; roll households beyond the cap wait in line, and the dispute is left to the next generation.

label.zh: 旧约仍用：续约之权归各旗王公
label.en: The old compact stands: renewal stays with the banner princes

options.effect: { if = { limit = { ywc_khq_at_1105 = yes } set_variable = { name = ywc_khq_b_outcome value = 3 } set_variable = { name = ywc_khq_old_compact_retained value = 1 } remove_variable = ywc_khq_b_pending remove_variable = ywc_khq_b_stage change_variable = { name = ywc_khq_popup_epoch add = 1 } } }

consequence_note.zh: 旧约原样保留，盟书仍由王公续签；册行与租地的诉求记录在案，不改旧制。
consequence_note.en: The old compact continues as it was, renewed by the princes alone; the roll rows' and lessees' claims stay on record without changing the old order.

label.zh: 此线收回，续约留待来年
label.en: Withdraw the line; renewal waits for another year

options.effect: { if = { limit = { ywc_khq_at_1105 = yes } set_variable = { name = ywc_khq_b_outcome value = 4 } remove_variable = ywc_khq_b_pending remove_variable = ywc_khq_b_stage change_variable = { name = ywc_khq_popup_epoch add = 1 } } }

consequence_note.zh: 已付的各项费用不退；续约之问由后续线自行提起。
consequence_note.en: Paid costs are not refunded; the renewal question may be raised anew by later lines.

purpose.zh: 收束：定盟书续签之权并登记余波
purpose.en: Settlement: fix who may renew the compact and record the aftermath
